title: Change an interface method signature and all its implementations
prompt: In the Billing module, change IDiscountPolicy.Apply(decimal amount) to Apply(decimal amount, string customerTier), with no default value, and update every implementation. Callers that are handed a tier by their own callers pass it on: InvoicePricing.Price and PriceAll and InvoiceQuote.Best and Chained gain a trailing string customerTier parameter with the same name. Callers that have no tier in scope, such as the existing tests, pass "standard". Change no behaviour: the tier is not used by the existing implementations.
